question:
Choose the word that means the same as the given word.

Lair
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1' **i.e. **'Concealment.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Lair" **refers to a secret or private place in which a person seeks concealment or seclusion; it often refers to a wild animal's den.(गुफा)
 
• **Concealment: **This noun refers to the action of hiding something or preventing it from being known.(छिपाव)
 
• This is the** closest in meaning to "lair" **because a lair is often a concealed or hidden place. 

Therefore, the** correct answer** is:** 'Concealment'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's explain all the options:
 
 
• **Arraign:** This verb means to call or bring someone before a court to answer a criminal charge. (मुकदमे का सामना करने के लिए बुलाना)
 
• **Apart: **This adverb means separated by a distance; at a specified distance from each other in time or space.(अलग)
 
• **Concurrent: **This adjective means occurring or existing simultaneously or side by side. (समानांतर)
 
 

4e:T960,

The correct answer is 'Option 2'.</strong&g
